items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that axioms (A1) to (A7) imply the existence of a degree map making the graded cohomology of a nonempty equidimensional smooth projective scheme a dual of itself, which is axiom (A) (statement lines 4852-4855). The proof (proof lines 4856-4926) constructs the unit and counit from the class of the diagonal, checks the two triangle identities, and compares the two pullbacks using the conormal sheaf of the diagonal. H3: a duality verification with an explicit computation, written out in full.
